NONE: › something that people say when you may not or cannot do something
沒門兒，不行，不許

example: I asked if we could go to the party, but Mom said no dice.
我問我們可不可以參加派對，媽媽說不行。

NONE: › very much
非常

example: It would please Granny no end if you wrote to her occasionally.
如果你能不時給奶奶寫封信，她會非常高興的。

NONE: B2 a lot of
大量；許多

example: If you don't want the job, there's no end of people willing to take your place.
如果你不想做這份工作了，不知會有多少人巴不得要頂替你的位置呢。

NONE: › If no expense is spared in arranging something, a lot of money is spent to make it extremely good.
不惜重金；不惜代價

example: No expense was spared in making the guests feel comfortable.
為了使客人住得舒適不惜重金。

NONE: › certainly not
決不！當然不！

example: "Are you coming to the concert?" "No fear!"
「你會來聽音樂會嗎？」「當然不會！」

NONE: › used to show that you consider a number to be surprisingly large
不少於，多達

example: No fewer than five hundred delegates attended the conference.
多達500名代表出席了大會。

NONE: › UK If you say there are no flies on someone, you mean that they cannot easily be deceived.
很精明，不會輕易上當受騙
› morally bad
道德敗壞的；品行惡劣的
› A no-good person does nothing useful or helpful and is therefore considered to be of little value.
（人）無用處的，無幫助的，一無是處的

example: I'd keep away from him if I were you - he's no good.
我要是你的話就離他遠點——他品行不端。
a no-good son of a bitch
一無是處的狗雜種

NONE: › not very good
並不太好的，不怎麼樣的，並不高明的

example: I'm afraid I am no great shakes as a cook/at cooking!
恐怕我對烹飪不太在行！

NONE: › without limits or controls
不受約束，沒有限制
› without any limits or controls
不受任何限制的；放縱的

example: This is comedy with no holds barred.
這部喜劇片搞笑得有些太過火了。
a no-holds-barred interview/account
暢所欲言的採訪／隨心所欲的描述
Mr Nixon may well have had a no-holds-barred approach to dealing with political adversaries.
尼克森先生在對付政敵時很可能是無所顧忌，甚麼手段都用了。

NONE: › something that you say to a child to stop them arguing with you when you want them to do something
（對兒童用語）別找藉口

example: I want no ifs or buts - just get on and tidy your room now.
別找藉口——現在就趕快打掃你的房間。

NONE: › really or honestly
真的；真誠的

example: No kidding, there were about 200 people at the party.
不騙你，晚會上有大約200人。

NONE: › used to show the importance of someone or something
（用於表示某人或某事很重要）正是，竟然，千真萬確

example: Who should arrive at the party but the prime minister, no less!
來參加派對的不正是首相嗎，千真萬確！

NONE: › used to show your surprise at a large number
絕不少於，不低於

example: There were no less than a thousand people there buying tickets.
至少有上千人在那裡買票。

NONE: B1 in the past but not now
不再，再也不

example: This building is no longer used.
這棟樓已經不用了。
She doesn't work here any longer.
她已經不在這裡工作了。

NONE: › it is not a problem
不要緊，無關緊要

example: "I don't have that form with me." "No matter - here's another."
「我沒帶那張表格。」「不要緊──這裡還有一張。」

NONE: B2 used to emphasize that something is always true, or that someone must do something
不管甚麼／何時／為甚麼等

example: I never seem to lose any weight, no matter how hard I try.
不管我怎麼努力，體重似乎都減不下來。
We've got to get to the airport on time, no matter what.
總之，我們必須按時到機場，不管用甚麼辦法。

NONE: › a great achievement
了不起的成就，不是容易的事

example: Getting the job finished on time was no mean achievement.
按時完成這項工作可真是不簡單。

NONE: › used to say a person is very good at a certain activity
很好的

example: He's no mean cook.
他是位很好的廚師。

NONE: › something that is said when someone has decided to stop thinking about the wishes and feelings of other people
不再是好好先生

example: I've had enough of people taking advantage of me. From now on it's no more Mr Nice Guy.
我真是受夠了老是被人利用。從現在起我不再做好好先生了。

NONE: › said to make someone feel less worried when they have not received information about someone or something, because if something bad had happened, they would have been told about it
沒有消息就是好消息，不聞凶訊便是吉

example: We haven't heard anything from the hospital today, but I suppose no news is good news.
我們今天沒有得到醫院的任何消息，但我想沒有消息就是好消息。

NONE: A2 no person
沒人，無人

example: At first I thought there was no one in the room.
起初我以為房裡沒有人。
"Who was that on the phone?" "No one you would know."
「誰來的電話？」「你不認識的人。」
I'd like to go to the concert but no one else (= no other person) wants to.
我想去聽音樂會，但其他人都不願意去。
No one told me she was ill.
沒人告訴我她病了。

NONE: › mainly UK something you say when it is very easy to guess something
…太容易猜了；不用猜都知道…

example: No prizes for guessing where Daniel is.
不用猜都知道丹尼爾在哪裡。

NONE: A2 said to show that you will or can do what someone has asked you to
沒問題
A2 used as a friendly answer when someone thanks you for something you have done
（用於回答對方的感謝）沒甚麼

example: "Can you get me to the station by 11.30?" "No problem."
「你能在11點半之前送我到車站嗎？」「沒問題。」
"Thanks for the lift." "No problem."
「謝謝你讓我搭便車。」「沒甚麼。」

NONE: › said to show that you will or can do what someone has asked you to
沒問題（表示答應做某事）
› used as a friendly answer when someone thanks you for something you have done
沒關係，不用謝（回答感謝）

example: I can burn you some copies of the CD, no problemo.
我可以替你燒錄一些光碟，沒甚麼問題。

NONE: › If you say there is no room for a feeling or type of behaviour, you mean it is not acceptable.
無法容忍，不能容許

example: In a small company like this, there is no room for laziness.
在這樣的小公司中，懶惰的員工是沒有容身之地的。

NONE: › an expression of surprise, often used as a joke when someone has told you something that is very obvious
（表示對剛聽到的話感到驚訝）不會吧

example: "This is hard work!" "No shit!"
「這事挺費勁的！」「不會吧！」

NONE: › certainly not
決不，絕不，絕對不

example: I'm not going to ride the subway, no sir!
我不會去乘地鐵，絕對不會！

NONE: C1 used to show that one thing happens immediately after another thing
剛…就…；一…就…

example: No sooner had I started mowing the lawn than it started raining.
我剛開始修剪草坪就下起了雨。

NONE: › used to say that you will do something immediately
馬上就做，說做就做
› used when you are disappointed that something that you hoped for did not happen
沒那麽走運

example: I was rather hoping it would rain today and I wouldn't have to go for a walk, but no such luck.
我特別希望今天能下雨，那樣我就不用出去散步了，不過沒有這樣的好事。

NONE: › If you say that something is no sweat, you mean that it will not be difficult or cause problems.
毫不費力，不麻煩，沒問題

example: "Can you fix my car for me?" "No sweat!"
「您能幫我修一下車嗎？」「沒問題！」

NONE: › despite
不是由於（某人）

example: It's no thanks to you that I got there on time.
我準時趕到沒你甚麼功勞。

NONE: B1 used to tell someone that something is impossible
決不，不可能
› used to say no in a forceful way
不，決不

example: I'm sorry but there's no way we can help you.
我很遺憾，但我們確實沒有辦法幫助你。
No way will she agree to you leaving early.
她決不會同意讓你早點離開。
"Come on, let me borrow your bike." "No way!"
「來，讓我借一下你的自行車。」「沒門兒！」

NONE: B2 it is not surprising
並不讓人驚訝；並不奇怪

example: No wonder the children are excited - this is the first time they've been abroad.
孩子們那麼興奮並不奇怪——這是他們第一次出國。
"If brutal killers like these two are at work, it is no wonder that so many Iraqis have fled," he said.
「如果有跟這兩個一樣兇殘的殺手在活動，難怪那麼多伊拉克人逃走了。」他說道。

NONE: › used to describe a person of little use or importance
（人）沒用的，無足輕重的

example: She left her no-account second husband and moved to Oregon.
她離開她那沒出息的第二任丈夫，搬到了奧勒崗州。

NONE: › an occasion when the ball is bowled (= thrown) in cricket and some other games in a way that is not allowed by the rules
（板球等運動中的）投球犯規
› something such as a decision that is very easy or obvious
不費腦筋之事；容易處理的問題

example: The decision was a complete no-brainer.
作這個決定完全不用多想。

NONE: › an amount by which someone's payment for insurance is reduced, especially for a motor vehicle, because they have not made any claims for a particular period
（尤指汽車保險在某段時期內沒有索賠要求而享有的）無索償折扣，無索賠贈金
› A no-fault agreement or system is one in which blame does not have to be proved before action can be taken, especially before money can be paid.
（尤指給付賠款前）不追究過失責任的，無過失的

example: a no-fault divorce
無責任離婚
a no-fault insurance policy
不追究過失責任的保險方案

NONE: › an area above a country that aircraft from other countries may not enter without risking attack
禁飛區

example: Aircraft will enforce the no-fly zone to protect UN forces on the ground.
為保護聯合國地面部隊的安全，將實施禁飛。

NONE: › A no-frills product or a service is basic and has no extra or unnecessary details.
樸實無華的；只提供最起碼必需品的

example: It's a no-frills store supplying only basic goods at affordable prices.
這家商店價格公道，只賣最基本的必需品。
a no-frills airline
只提供必需品的航班

NONE: › an area, especially in a town, where it is very dangerous to go, usually because a group of people who have weapons prevent the police, army, and other people from entering
（尤指城鎮裡武裝分子控制的）危險地帶，禁區
› someone or something that will fail
必定失敗的人；無成功希望的事

example: He's a real/total no-hoper - he'll never achieve anything.
他簡直無可救藥——做甚麼都一事無成。

NONE: › A no-lose set of conditions is one in which there will be a happy and successful result whatever happens.
必定成功的；註定美滿的

example: For him this is a no-lose campaign - he will become either vice president-elect or a much stronger presidential contender for the next election.
不論結果如何，他都是這次競選的贏家——要麼獲選為副總統，要麼就成為下屆總統選舉中更強勁的競爭者。

S or U: › [ S or U ] an area or strip of land that no one owns or controls, such as a strip of land between two countries' borders, especially in a war
（尤指戰時兩國交界處的）無人地帶，真空地帶
S: › [ S ] a situation or area of activity where there are no rules, or that no one understands or controls because it belongs neither to one type nor another
性質尚未確定的形勢（或領域），真空地帶

example: to be lost/stranded/stuck in no-man's-land
迷失在／滯留在／困在無人地帶
They found themselves trapped in the no-man's-land between the two warring factions.
他們發現自己困在交戰雙方之間的真空地帶。
The families of people who die in custody are in a legal no-man's-land when they try to discover what went wrong.
囚犯在監禁期間死亡，其家屬試圖查清事實真相時，卻找不到相關的法律支持。

NONE: › something that is thought to be unsuitable or unacceptable
不合適（或不可接受）的事物

example: Total nudity is still a definite no-no on most of Europe's beaches.
歐洲大多數海灘仍嚴格禁止全裸。

NONE: › practical and serious, and only interested in doing what is necessary or achieving what is intended, without silly ideas or methods
務實嚴肅的

example: a no-nonsense manner/leader
務實認真的態度／領導
a no-nonsense approach to child-rearing
養育子女方面嚴肅務實的態度

NONE: › used to describe something that is done or given without people in authority asking for information or explanations first
無需解釋的；無需說明的

example: The customer has only to bring the goods in to any branch and an immediate, no-questions-asked refund or replacement will be provided.
顧客只要把所購的貨物帶至任何一家分店，無須任何說明，就能立即得到退款或換貨。

NONE: › a person who is expected but does not arrive
未按預訂到場者，未如約出席者

example: Two important witnesses were no-shows.
兩位重要證人並未如約出庭。
a no-show passenger
已預訂座位但未搭乘的旅客

NONE: › A no-win set of conditions is one in which whatever happens there will be an unhappy and unsuccessful result.
註定失敗的

example: to be in a no-win situation
註定失敗

NONE: › said about a place or space that is very small
空間很狹小；（地方）連轉個身都困難
